description: Praise the oligarchy!!! Idle hands must be chopped off!!
transcript: What did you learn today, kids? When we are not productive enough, we're not productive enough. And why is that? Because if we don't feel ashamed of ourselves when we're not productive enough, we won't need to numb with brain rot. And what might happen if you stop numbing? We'll have the time and energy to think and make art. And why is that dangerous? Idle hands make political decisions. And what do scrolling hands make? Mining for our darkened giggles.
